title: Foundations & Architecture
description: Discover how human-readable source code transforms into machine-executable instructions through compilation, bytecode, and the Java Virtual Machine.

title: Language Basics & Data Types
description: Explore the 8 fundamental primitive data types in Java, understand memory allocation on the stack, byte sizes, range limits, and variable identifier rules.

title: Control Flow & Logic
description: Direct program execution dynamically using if, else if, else, nested logic, and boolean expressions without logic flaws.

title: Methods & Modular Code
description: Decompose programs into modular, reusable blocks. Master method signatures, the call stack, stack frames, and pass-by-value semantics.

title: Arrays & Memory Structure
description: Understand fixed-size indexed memory buffers on the JVM Heap. Master default values, bounds checking, cache locality, and enhanced for-each traversal.

title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) Essentials
description: Master the foundation of Object-Oriented Programming: classes as architectural blueprints, objects as heap instances, reference variables on the stack, and Garbage Collection eligibility.

title: OOP Inheritance, Polymorphism & Abstraction
description: Establish IS-A hierarchies with the extends keyword. Master super() constructor chaining, method overriding rules, covariant returns, and final class/method locks.

title: Modern Java Data Modeling
description: Eliminate boilerplate for immutable data carrier classes. Master records, component accessors, synthesized equals/hashCode, compact constructors, and invariant validation.

title: Exception Handling
description: Understand the Java error taxonomy rooted at java.lang.Throwable. Contrast fatal JVM Errors (OutOfMemoryError) with recoverable Exceptions and traverse stack traces.

title: Generics & Collections Framework
description: Master compile-time type safety with generic classes, methods, bounded type parameters, and type erasure mechanics.

title: Functional Programming & Streams
description: Master lambda expressions, Single Abstract Method (SAM) interfaces, @FunctionalInterface, and standard functional types in java.util.function.

title: File I/O, NIO.2 & Date/Time
description: Master byte vs character streams, BufferedReader / BufferedWriter, UTF-8 character encoding, buffer flushing, and stream resource closing.

title: Concurrency & Multithreading
description: Master the operating system thread abstraction, the six thread states, daemon threads, joining, and interruption mechanics.

title: JVM Internals & Memory Architecture
description: Explore the internal memory layout of the JVM: Heap, Metaspace, Thread Stacks, PC Registers, and JMM happens-before rules.

title: Reflection, Annotations & JPMS
description: Master declarative metadata with custom annotations, meta-annotations (@Retention, @Target), and runtime reflection processing.

title: Data Access & Build Tools
description: Master relational database connectivity, SQL injection defense with PreparedStatement, ResultSet cursor traversal, and ACID transactions.

title: Web Architecture & The Jakarta EE Evolution
description: Understand the historic evolution from Sun J2EE and Oracle Java EE to Eclipse Jakarta EE, package namespace migration from javax.* to jakarta.*, and server compatibility matrices.

title: Web Containers & Packaging
description: Explore the Web Archive (WAR) anatomy, the protected WEB-INF boundary, web.xml vs annotations, Catalina container hierarchy, and Tomcat deployment pipelines.

title: Servlets Deep Dive
description: Deep dive into how Jakarta Servlets work: the container lifecycle (init, service, destroy), multithreaded request dispatching, and thread-safety fundamentals.

title: State Management, Filters & Security
description: Bridge stateless HTTP with stateful web interactions: master server-side HttpSession memory, JSESSIONID tracking, secure Cookie flags, and session invalidation.

title: JavaServer Pages (JSP) & Templating
description: Master legacy JSP architecture: understand the Jasper translation lifecycle into _jspService(), directives, scriptlets vs expressions, the 9 implicit objects, and standard actions.

title: Production Web Development
description: Architect production web applications by separating concerns into Model (POJOs), View (JSP templates in WEB-INF), and Controller (Jakarta Servlets).

title: Jakarta EE Enterprise Stack Overview
description: Bridge the object-relational impedance mismatch using Jakarta Persistence (JPA), Hibernate, @Entity mappings, and JPQL queries.

title: Spring Core & Inversion of Control
description: Explore the architectural foundation of the Spring Inversion of Control (IoC) container, comparing the lightweight BeanFactory with the enterprise-ready ApplicationContext, lazy vs eager instantiation, and contextual infrastructure.

title: Spring Boot Architecture & Configuration
description: Deconstruct Spring Boot's opinionated architecture: condition evaluation algorithms, starter dependencies, META-INF/spring/org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration.imports, and embedded web servers (Tomcat/Jetty/Undertow).

title: RESTful Web Services & Global Error Handling
description: Architect resilient, production-grade REST APIs using Spring Web MVC: HTTP method mappings (@GetMapping to @DeleteMapping), URI template variables (@PathVariable), query parameters (@RequestParam), payload deserialization (@RequestBody), and explicit HTTP status code semantics via ResponseEntity<T>.

title: Persistence with Spring Data JPA & Databases
description: Explore the architectural foundation of Spring Data JPA, covering the cohesive repository interface hierarchy, dynamic runtime proxy generation, entity lifecycle states, and automated snapshot-based dirty checking.

title: Enterprise Security with Spring Security 6
description: Understand the component-based security architecture in Spring Security 6: declarative SecurityFilterChain bean configuration, URL authorization matchers, stateless CSRF semantics, and production password hashing with BCrypt and Argon2.

title: Master Annotations Reference Dictionary
description: The definitive, cross-referenced architectural dictionary categorizing and comparing core annotations across Java SE Core, Jakarta EE enterprise specifications, and the Spring Boot production ecosystem.

title: Production Libraries & Distributed Systems
description: Eliminate repetitive boilerplate in enterprise Java applications using Project Lombok's annotation processor and MapStruct's compile-time, type-safe bean mapping engine.

title: Advanced Persistence, Dynamic Queries & Auditing
description: Build type-safe, dynamic search queries in Spring Data JPA using JpaSpecificationExecutor and Specification<T>, composing complex multi-criteria boolean expressions without string concatenation.

title: Enterprise Identity & OAuth2 / OIDC Architecture
description: Configure Spring Security 6 as a stateless OAuth2 Resource Server: asymmetric RS256 token validation using remote JWK Sets (JWKS), custom JwtAuthenticationConverter for role extraction, and realm claim mapping.

title: Asynchronous, Distributed Scheduling & Batch Processing
description: Decouple long-running operations from HTTP threads in Spring Boot: @EnableAsync, custom ThreadPoolTaskExecutor tuning, saturation policies, CompletableFuture aggregation, and AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler.

title: Real-Time Web & Asynchronous Streaming
description: Build real-time full-duplex communication in Spring Boot: WebSocket handshake, STOMP sub-protocol messaging, in-memory and external message brokers (RabbitMQ/ActiveMQ), @MessageMapping, and SimpMessagingTemplate.

title: Relational Database Essentials & SQL
description: Master core relational concepts: tables, columns, rows, primary keys, foreign keys, relationships (1:1, 1:N, M:N), and normalization.

title: Polyglot Persistence & NoSQL Systems
description: Compare relational and non-relational database architectures: tabular models vs document stores, ACID vs BASE, and CAP theorem trade-offs in distributed systems.
